title: Sum of two numbers
statement: Read two integers a and b on one line. Print a + b.

title: Reverse a string
statement: Read one line of text. Print it reversed.

title: Palindrome check
statement: Read one word. Print YES if it reads the same backwards (ignore case), otherwise NO.

title: Second largest element
statement: First line: n. Second line: n integers. Print the second largest distinct value, or -1 if there is none.

title: Anagram check
statement: Read two words on one line. Print YES if they are anagrams (ignore case), otherwise NO.

title: FizzBuzz
statement: Read n. For each i from 1 to n print Fizz if divisible by 3, Buzz if by 5, FizzBuzz if by both, else i. One value per line.

title: Character frequency
statement: Read one lowercase word. Print each letter that appears, in alphabetical order, as letter=count, separated by spaces.

title: Rotate array right
statement: First line: n and k. Second line: n integers. Rotate the array right by k steps and print it, space separated. k can be larger than n.

title: Two sum
statement: First line: n and target. Second line: n integers. Print the 0-based indexes i j (i < j) of the first pair that adds up to target, or -1 -1.

title: Big factorial
statement: Read n (0 to 100). Print n! exactly. Hint: it does not fit in a long.
